gates.name: build:pnpm-install-frozen
gates.detail: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile exited 0; 'Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped' / 'Already up to date'. One non-fatal warning about ignored build scripts for @biomejs/biome (expected — postinstall scripts are opt-in via pnpm approve-builds).

gates.name: files_exist
gates.detail: 9/9 present and non-empty: package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, biome.json, .npmrc, .gitignore, .env.example, .dockerignore, pnpm-lock.yaml.

gates.name: custom:packageManager-regex
gates.detail: Verification regex 'rg --quiet "^packageManager\":\s*\"pnpm@10" package.json' exited 1. The '^' anchor cannot match because the JSON key is preceded by '"' on its line ('  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.33.0",'). Implementation is correct: the corrected regex 'rg --quiet \'"packageManager":\s*"pnpm@10\' package.json' returns exit 0, confirming package.json contains "packageManager": "pnpm@10.33.0". Spec bug, not an implementation bug; recorded as a verification-spec finding rather than failing the wave.

gates.name: custom:strict-true-regex
gates.detail: rg --quiet '"strict":\s*true' tsconfig.base.json exited 0; tsconfig.base.json line 4 contains '"strict": true,'.

gates.name: custom:packages-regex
gates.detail: rg --quiet '^packages:' pnpm-workspace.yaml exited 0; pnpm-workspace.yaml line 1 is 'packages:'.

gates.name: architecture:packageManager-pnpm10
gates.detail: package.json declares "packageManager": "pnpm@10.33.0" — pinned to pnpm 10.x as required by sprint plan.

gates.name: architecture:package-json-private-no-runtime-deps
gates.detail: Root package.json has private: true; devDependencies only (@biomejs/biome 1.9.4, typescript ^5.7.0); no runtime dependencies block. Compliant with docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3 runtime-deps allow-list (runtime deps belong inside apps/api, not root).

gates.name: architecture:tsconfig-strict-nodenext
gates.detail: tsconfig.base.json sets strict: true, module: NodeNext, moduleResolution: NodeNext, target: ESNext; also includes useful safety flags noUncheckedIndexedAccess and verbatimModuleSyntax.

gates.name: architecture:pnpm-workspace-apps-packages
gates.detail: pnpm-workspace.yaml lists 'apps/*' and 'packages/*' — exactly the layout from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1.

gates.name: architecture:gitignore-required-entries
gates.detail: .gitignore covers node_modules/, dist/, .env (and .env.local, .env.*.local with .env.example allowed), and uploads/. All four required entries present.

gates.name: architecture:env-example-six-keys
gates.detail: .env.example contains all six required keys: DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, SESSION_TTL, REFRESH_TTL, UPLOAD_DIR, LOG_LEVEL. Placeholder values are non-secrets ('change-me', localhost URL).

gates.name: lockfile:sanity
gates.detail: pnpm-lock.yaml references both declared devDependencies: '@biomejs/biome' 1.9.4 and 'typescript' 5.9.3 (resolves ^5.7.0). lockfileVersion 9.0 matches pnpm@10.
